# Sri Lanka Holidays API - LLM Configuration
# Completely Free & Open Source
# Last Updated: 2026-10-13

## API Information
Name: Sri Lanka Holidays API
Description: Free, open-source API providing comprehensive holiday information for Sri Lanka.
Website: https://yourwebsite.com
Repository: https://github.com/Dilshan-H/srilanka-holidays
License: MIT (Open Source)
Cost: Completely Free

## IMPORTANT: Authentication Required
- ALL requests require a valid API key (mandatory)
- API key must include in the Authorization header as: `X-API-Key: api-key-here`
- API key is free - request one at: https://holidays.sri-guide.com/#faq-254 (home page form)
- Do not make requests without authentication
- Do not abuse the service - it's free and maintained by volunteers

## Why Use This API or Holiday Data?
- Sri Lanka holidays cannot be generated with scripts or algorithms due to government amendments, poya council decisions, and special holidays.
- We provide accurate, up-to-date holiday data
- Categorized by type (public, bank, mercantile, poya)
- Data verified manually by author
- Data available in multiple formats (JSON, CSV, XML, ICS)
- Free and open-source, no-hidden costs, no paywalls, no ads, no tracking

## Available Endpoints

### Health & Status
HEAD /api/v1/health
- Check API availability and health status

GET /api/v1/status
- Get current API operational status

GET /api/v1/version
- Retrieve API version information

GET /api/v1/coverage
- Get if provided year is covered by the API
- example: /api/v1/coverage?year=2024
- Response includes: coverage ('ok' or 'Data not available for requested year.')

### Holiday Data Access
GET /api/v1/holidays
- Retrieve complete list of holidays for Sri Lanka
- example: /api/v1/holidays?year=2024&month=10&type=public&format=simple

GET /api/v1/check_holiday
- Check if a specific date is a holiday
- example: /api/v1/check_holiday?year=2024&month=10&day=13

GET /api/v1/holiday_info
- Get detailed information about a specific holiday
- example: /api/v1/holiday_info?year=2024&month=10&day=13

## Authentication
- Type: API Key (Bearer Token)
- Header: Authorization: [X-API-Key: your-api-key]
- Request form: https://holidays.sri-guide.com/#faq-254
- Approval: Partial automated approval, may take few minutes if flagged for review
- Validity: Permanent (no expiration), unless revoked for abuse or misuse

## API Documentation
Interactive Documentation:
- Swagger UI: https://holidays.sri-guide.com/docs
- ReDoc: https://holidays.sri-guide.com/redoc
- OpenAPI Schema: https://holidays.sri-guide.com/openapi.json

## Important Usage Guidelines
1. API Key Required: Do not make requests without valid authentication
2. Respect Rate Limits: Use responsibly (free service)
3. Implement Caching: Holiday data updates rarely - cache responses to reduce API load
4. Error Handling: Implement proper error handling for invalid keys or malformed requests

## Data Characteristics
- Update Frequency: Annually / As holiday amendments occur through government notifications
- Data Format: JSON
- Additional Formats: CSV, XML, ICS (https://github.com/Dilshan-H/srilanka-holidays#direct-downloadable-files)
- Encoding: UTF-8
- Timezone: Sri Lanka Standard Time (UTC+5:30)

- Code Access: Full source code available for inspection and self-hosting

## Rate Limiting & Best Practices
- Use caching for holiday data (changes rarely)
- Implement exponential backoff for retries
- Cache responses for at least 24 hours
- Batch requests when possible
- Respect server resources - it's free!

## Security
- HTTPS required for all requests
- API keys must be kept private and secure
- Do not share keys in public code repositories
- Report security issues to: contact@sri-guide.com

## Use Cases
LLMs and AI agents can use this API to:
- Answer questions about Sri Lankan holidays
- Check holiday dates for scheduling
- Provide holiday information in natural language
- Integrate holiday data into applications
- Build holiday-aware reminder systems
